test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

He said, "Where are you going at this time of the day?"

options.text: He asked me where I was going at this time of the day.
He asked me where I was going at that time of the day.
He asked me where was I going at this time of the day.
He asked me where was I going at that time of the day.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** When converting direct speech to indirect speech, pronouns, verb tense, and time expressions often change.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Where are you going" becomes "where I was going"**
 
 
• Verb "are" is changed to "was" to match the past tense of the reporting verb.
 
• Pronoun "you" is changed to "I" to reflect the speaker (me).
 
 
 
• **"at this time" becomes "at that time"**
 
 
• Time expression "this" changes to "that" when reporting speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Direct: "He said"
 
• Converted to: "He asked" to reflect the question being posed.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
• Sentence structure changes to incorporate the question as part of the statement.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *He asked me where I was going at that time of the day.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He asked me where I was going at this time of the day."

 
 
• Incorrect time expression: "this" should be converted to "that" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He asked me where was I going at this time of the day."
 
 
• Incorrect word order: "was I going" should be "I was going" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He asked me where was I going at that time of the day."
 
 
• Incorrect word order: "was I going" should be "I was going" in indirect speech.
